newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hartwall to continue talks with Coke - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Hartwall to continue talks with Coke - CEO.

text.p: Finnish beverages group Hartwall Oy CEO said on Tuesday that the group was likely to continue talks with Coca-Cola Company even after its current licensing deal expires on March 15.
"If we haven't reached an agreement by March 15, I believe we will continue negotiations," Hartwall CEO Jussi Lansio told Reuters by telephone.
Hartwall has repeatedly said in the past few months that it is in talks with Coca-Cola to continue to the current production and distribution of Coca-Cola soft drinks in Finland.
Danish brewer Carlsberg said on Tuesday it had reached agreement with Coca-Cola on a joint venture, CCNB, for distribution and production of soft drinks in Denmark and Sweden.
Carlsberg said its aim was that the Coca-Cola licensees in Finland and Norway would join Coca-Cola Nordic Beverages (CCNB) as well.
